name: Data Integrity Audit and Repair
description: Audit a data subtree for duplicates, placeholders, and shape drift; repair in place with full accounting; never drop silently.

steps.description: Enumerate the subtree, group by logical identity and count duplicates - full accounting before any change. Hands on the duplicate report.
steps.name: enumerate_and_group

steps.description: Resolve the canonical by min id (order-independent) and verify wiring and consumers target the canonicals. Hands on the canonical set.
steps.name: canonical_resolve

steps.description: Propose the repair: delete or annotate the non-canonical copies per the approved plan, logging deleted/kept counts and a zero-failure check; never drop silently. Hands on the accounting. Applying the repair needs a data-repair capability that is not registered.
steps.name: repair_with_accounting

steps.description: State how to re-run the consumer that drifted (e.g. boot wiring) and verify the convergence count is 0. Hands on the convergence check. Running it needs a fresh-process test capability that is not registered.
steps.name: verify_convergence

missing_capabilities: repair stored data: delete or annotate non-canonical containers with full accounting
run a test or fresh-process verification against the host (e.g. QueryGraph from a new process, a regression test run)
